text: Political communication studies is a discipline formed by the intersection of political science and communication studies. It focuses on the dissemination mechanism, effect and social impact of political information, aiming to cultivate professional talents with political theory literacy, communication technology ability and interdisciplinary thinking. Through course study, students will master the classic theories, contemporary practices and research methods of political communication, understand the interactive relationship between politics and media, and possess the ability to analyze and solve practical problems in political communication.
